summary: Trivial __thiscall accessor that returns the this pointer advanced by a fixed 16-byte stride. Callers (NetworkAccept and two other functions) use it to walk a sequence of fixed-size 16-byte records.

operations.description: Compute this + 16, advancing the receiver pointer by a fixed 16-byte stride.

unresolved: Type of the pointed-to 16-byte record and the owning object are unknown; no fields or globals are referenced.
Why the stride is exactly 16 bytes is not evidenced from this function alone.
